admissions.name: book_visit
admissions.description: Book the slot the contact chose. Requires their name and phone. Returns a booking code to confirm back. Only call after the contact picked a specific slot.

slot_time.description: Exactly as returned by get_visit_slots (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM)

phone.description:
Phone as the contact typed it

{maxLength: 32, minLength: 7}

admissions.name: get_fee_table
admissions.description: Approved fee structure (public). Returns fee heads with amount_pkr and frequency for a class/program (school-wide heads like admission fee are included), or the whole table. Quote amounts exactly; never add them up.

program_or_class.description: Class or program as the institution names it, e.g. "Class 3", "Playgroup", "BS Computer Science"; null for the whole table

admissions.name: get_key_dates
admissions.description: Approved admission calendar: admissions open/close, last date to apply, test and interview dates, merit lists, session start, vacations. Optional filter word.

kind.description: Optional filter word, e.g. "test", "last date", "merit", "session"; null = all

admissions.name: get_programs
admissions.description: Approved list of classes/programs with level, duration, eligibility, seats and program deadline. Use for 'which programs', eligibility and seats questions.

level.description: Optional filter, e.g. "BS", "MS", "Intermediate", "FSc", or a program name

admissions.name: get_scholarships
admissions.description: Approved scholarships/concessions with their criteria and amounts. Never promise eligibility; quote the criteria.

admissions.name: get_transport_routes
admissions.description: Approved transport (van/bus) routes with areas covered and monthly fare in PKR. Pass the contact's area to filter.

area.description: Area/locality the contact lives in; null for all routes

admissions.name: get_visit_slots
admissions.description: Open slots for a campus visit, admission test or counselling session in a date range (default: next two weeks). Returns slot_time strings to use with book_visit.

from_date.description: First day to look at (YYYY-MM-DD); null=today

to_date.description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD); null = two weeks ahead

admissions.name: handoff_to_human
admissions.description: Hand the conversation to office staff (they reply in this chat). Use when the contact asks for a person, complains, disputes a fee, mentions hardship, or you cannot help after two tries.

admissions.name: save_lead
admissions.description: Save or update the contact as an admission lead (deduplicated by phone). Use only details the contact gave. Returns which fields are still missing.

phone.description: Phone exactly as the contact typed it

admissions.name: schedule_followup
admissions.description: Schedule the office to follow up on a date the contact agreed to (sent later as a template message). Use when they want time to decide.

when.description: Date the contact agreed to be contacted (YYYY-MM-DD)

reason.description:
Why, in a few words

{maxLength: 200, minLength: 1}

admissions.name: search_knowledge
admissions.description: Search the institution's own documents (prospectus, notices, policies). Use for descriptive questions: facilities, process, requirements, uniform, timings, hostel. Returns passages in <source> tags. Numbers in passages are NOT authoritative — use the get_* fact tools for fees, dates, eligibility and fares.

queries.description:
1-3 short queries: the contact's wording, an English rewrite, and an Urdu-script rewrite if they wrote in Urdu
